posteriores.texto: Por causa dos filhos de Israel, Jericó mantinha-se fechada e permanecia bloqueada: não havia quem saísse, nem quem entrasse.
O SENHOR disse a Josué: “Veja: entreguei Jericó em sua mão, juntamente com seu rei e os guerreiros valentes.

kjv.texto: And the captain of the Lord’s host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.

vizinhos.14: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the Lord am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?
